totals.rows_scoped: contract.invariants, contract.not_exposed, instructions, best_practices across the 7 core/seam ideal facets and their 7 -implement facets (core-document, core-graph, core-judge, core-ledger, core-planner, seam-dispatch, seam-state, and each's -implement); in the -implement facets, adapters rows and definition_of_done were off limits per instruction and not touched. open_questions not touched: every row there already carries sources and a quote.

method: Same method as sourcing-01 (cap- layer) and sourcing-02c (xc- layer): for each proposed row, ran python3 tools/kb.py show plus grep -i over kb/facts.jsonl, kb/target-facts.jsonl, kb/reference-facts.jsonl and kb/research.jsonl (each skill's own X-<skill>-* lens and X-cross-structure-*/X-end-to-end-* records), and read kb/decisions.jsonl for background only - no D- id is a valid citation prefix per schemas/skill.schema.json, so the Dispatch and State D- design records informed judgement but were never cited. Converted to sourced only when a verbatim quote from a cited record supported the row's own specific claim rather than merely sharing vocabulary with it: this is why several rows that already carried a background source in their proposed form (core-document invariants on document immutability, core-planner-implement's migration-stage instructions, seam-state's two rows citing docs/decomposition.md, which is not a citable kb id under this schema) stayed proposed rather than being converted on the strength of an adjacent but non-supporting record. REF-anchored rows (docs/reference/composable-plan.md, cited per schemas/skill.schema.json's own rule that a REF- citation alone does not make a row sourced to the host or the target) and pure references/*.md progressive-disclosure pointers were left untouched with no added query, matching the sourcing-01/02c precedent that a navigational or REF-anchored row is not researchable in the same sense - 21 rows across the 14 skills fall in this class, including every 'Apply build-adapter-pair: ... proposed pointer, see that skill' row in the six -implement facets that already read as a one-clause pointer naming the sibling and needed no further trimming. No row was deleted or newly trimmed as sibling-restating padding this iteration: none of the remaining proposed rows were found to restate a sibling's contract beyond what a pointer already covered. The other 45 proposed rows had the research query that would source them appended verbatim to their text (or their instruction 'action' field), naming what a fetched - not search-only - source would need to establish to convert the row, including two rows in seam-state naming the docs/decomposition.md citability gap explicitly.
quality_note: Every candidate quote was checked programmatically as a literal substring of at least one of its row's cited kb records before conversion (mirroring tools/validate_skills.py's own substring check, including its fallback to the full json.dumps of a research.jsonl record when no text field is present). Cross-skill quote reuse was checked against each edited skill's actual composes_with.builds_on chain plus agentic-stack (always an implicit owner): the heavily-shared design-rule facts (F-a7-03, F-b1-04, F-b1-06, F-b1-07, F-b1-08, F-meta-04, F-a3-09, F-b4-07, F-b5-03, X-cross-structure-042/043) had most of their natural substrings already claimed by agentic-stack, build-definition-of-done or build-adapter-pair inside a builds_on relationship; each such conversion was re-quoted to a different verbatim substring of the same record until no owner collision remained, rather than reusing the exact (id, quote) pair those siblings already hold. tools/render_skill.py and tools/validate_skills.py --only <skill> were run after every skill: final result is 0 errors for all 14 skills, and the pre-existing MECH-2 restate-and-extend warnings (1-6 per skill, all in rows this ceremony did not touch) and the two seam-dispatch cross-skill restate warnings are byte-identical to the pre-ceremony baseline, verified per file with git show HEAD before editing - no new warning was introduced.
